scope: COV-013/019s: complete native sense/example audit for the existing 가지다/갖다 auxiliary paths, lexical homonym preservation and individual-case tracking. No runtime change; broader original COV-019 and COV-013 scope remains open.

decisions.decision: Both native senses use the same fixed -어 가지고 / -어 갖고 form and permit a preceding verb or adjective. All original example groups and dialogue lines are retained. Joined excerpts verify the existing structural paths without selecting result-maintenance versus cause/means/reason, recommending spelling or imposing undocumented register restrictions.

Eight forbidden judgments restrict only the auxiliary-role connector/right-inflection paths. The same-source independent lexical homonyms retain present/adnominal and connective forms; no global lemma ban or sense borrowing is introduced.

Complete independent lexical entries remain separate from the two auxiliary entries. Their forms and examples are preserved in the fixture and four positive lexical-role regressions. They are not inventory entries and this audit does not certify their contextual senses.

search.rule: Aligned lemma 가지/갖 with KAIST px or GSD VX auxiliary tag. Complete matching sentence blocks are retained unchanged; lexical VV/pvg homonyms are not called auxiliary evidence.

corpus.limits: The joined token is source gold; the separately written auxiliary is a separate token. No cross-token candidate is invented and no annotations are repaired.

frontend.visual_limits: Lexical 싸다 can show the dictionary hint cheap instead of a contextual wrapping sense; 가지다/갖다 auxiliary translations are the native romanized gajida/gatda labels. Structural role/source correctness is tested; this audit does not turn hints into contextual translations.

nix.initial_source_snapshot_failure: First build omitted untracked fixtures. Verified terminal failure; staged new files and reran. The corrected Git-backed source build passed all 685 release tests.

checks.note: Checks passed before this final documentation/queue update; final source check is required before committing. No other platform execution is claimed.

preview.restoration: Previous preview was not listening (connection refused). Started the verified wrapper on the free port and verified all 170 cases; no unrelated process was stopped.

runtime_compatibility.evidence_limit: Identical executables/assets and unchanged pinned dictionary/source data preserve runtime behavior. Earlier full candidate/corpus/novel and timing evidence is referenced without presenting new measurements. Current pinned full-corpus, browser, CLI/HTTP, source-integrity and Nix release tests were rerun; no new throughput or general precision claim is made.

inventory.interpretation: Scoped source/structural dispositions with explicit limitations; full-entry contextual correctness and independent Korean-language review are not certified.

remaining_original_scope: All original open checklist items remain required; COV-013 still has 326 unreviewed inventory entries.
Contextual auxiliary versus lexical sense selection, semantic suitability and register remain open under COV-019.
